IMC Services — Hub & Hero Implementation Pack (Trae-ready)
Goal

Make the IMC Hub menu read logically and feel premium:

Elegant tooltips (from existing data-tooltip attributes)

“Current: …” pill auto-filled from the active page

Right-side Details Rail that mirrors tooltip copy (so users aren’t forced to hover)

Show Services Hub subsections only on the Services page

Keep all styles inside this page (safe to inline), no breaking changes to your HTML

Your page already has:

body data-page="services"

Good link structure and data-tooltip attributes on the Hub links

New hero headline & CTAs

This pack adds CSS + a small JS module. No other files are required.

0) Backup

Make a quick copy of your current HTML file.

1) Paste this CSS (near the end of your <head>, after your current styles)

If you prefer, you can place this in ./assets/css/lg-advanced-navigation.css. Keeping it inline is fine.

<style>
/* ============= IMC HUB POLISH ============= */

/* “Current: …” pill just below the nav header */
.lg-nav-current {
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem;
  margin:10px 0 12px; font-size:.9rem; opacity:.9;
}
.lg-nav-current .pill {
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  border-radius:12px; padding:6px 10px; font-weight:600;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--lg-coral) 0%, var(--lg-teal) 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
}

/* Active hub link gets a subtle glow + gradient underline */
.lg-nav-link.active{
  position:relative;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);
  border-radius:12px;
}
.lg-nav-link.active::after{
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:auto 0 -2px 0; height:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--lg-coral), var(--lg-teal));
  border-radius:2px;
}

/* Tooltips powered by [data-tooltip] (desktop only) */
.lg-nav-link[data-tooltip]{ position:relative; }
.lg-nav-link[data-tooltip]::before,
.lg-nav-link[data-tooltip]::after{
  position:absolute; left:calc(100% + 12px); top:50%;
  transform:translateY(-50%);
  opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:opacity .12s ease, transform .12s ease;
}
.lg-nav-link[data-tooltip]::before{
  content:attr(data-tooltip);
  max-width:280px; width:max-content;
  background:rgba(20,20,20,.96);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  color:#fff; padding:10px 12px; border-radius:10px;
  line-height:1.45; font-size:.9rem; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}
.lg-nav-link[data-tooltip]::after{
  content:""; width:8px; height:8px; background:rgba(20,20,20,.96);
  border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  transform:translate(-6px,-50%) rotate(45deg);
}
.lg-nav-link:hover::before,
.lg-nav-link:hover::after,
.lg-nav-link:focus::before,
.lg-nav-link:focus::after{
  opacity:1; transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(0);
}

/* Right-side Details Rail inside the nav (desktop only) */
.lg-nav-menu{ position:relative; }
.lg-nav-details {
  position:absolute; right:-300px; top:68px; width:280px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  border-radius:14px; padding:12px; color:#fff;
}
.lg-nav-details h4{ margin:.1rem 0 .2rem; font-weight:700; }
.lg-nav-details p{ margin:0 0 .6rem; opacity:.9; font-size:.92rem; line-height:1.45; }
.lg-nav-details a{ color:var(--lg-teal); font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; }

/* Show Services page sections only on Services */
body[data-page="services"] .services-sections{ display:block; }
body:not([data-page="services"]) .services-sections{ display:none; }

/* Keyboard focus: visible, brand-safe */
.lg-nav-link:focus{
  outline:2px solid rgba(46,211,198,.6);
  outline-offset:2px; border-radius:12px;
}

/* Mobile/tablet: hide hover-tooltips; Details rail becomes inline */
@media (max-width: 960px){
  .lg-nav-link[data-tooltip]::before,
  .lg-nav-link[data-tooltip]::after{ display:none; }
  .lg-nav-details{ position:static; width:auto; margin:8px 0 0; }
}
</style>

2) Paste this JS (right before </body>, AFTER your existing lg-advanced-navigation.js)
<script>
/* IMC Hub Enhancements (Current pill, Details Rail, Services sections gating) */
(function(){
  const nav = document.querySelector('.lg-nav-menu');
  if(!nav) return;

  /* Insert "Current: ..." pill (once) under the nav header */
  const header = nav.querySelector('.lg-nav-header');
  if(header && !nav.querySelector('.lg-nav-current')){
    const currentWrap = document.createElement('div');
    currentWrap.className = 'lg-nav-current';
    currentWrap.innerHTML = `<span class="pill">Current: <span id="lg-current-page">—</span></span>`;
    header.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', currentWrap);
  }

  /* Build a Details Rail (once) */
  if(!nav.querySelector('.lg-nav-details')){
    const rail = document.createElement('aside');
    rail.className = 'lg-nav-details';
    rail.innerHTML = `
      <h4>Services</h4>
      <p>Explore the full suite—strategy, narrative, campaigns, and GTM systems.</p>
      <a href="#services">Jump to Services</a>
    `;
    nav.appendChild(rail);
  }

  /* Map hub pages to detail copy */
  const detailsCopy = {
    services: {
      title: 'Services',
      desc: 'Explore the full suite—strategy, narrative, campaigns, and GTM systems.',
      href: '#services'
    },
    advisory: {
      title: 'Advisory',
      desc: 'Get clarity fast: positioning, roadmap, and executive guidance.',
      href: './advisory/index.html'
    },
    scopeiq: {
      title: 'ScopeIQ',
      desc: 'Start with a 5-minute diagnostic, then map services to your needs.',
      href: './scopeiq-wizard/index.html'
    }
  };

  const links = [...nav.querySelectorAll('.lg-nav-section .lg-nav-link')];

  /* Determine current from body[data-page] or the .active link */
  const pageHint = (document.body.getAttribute('data-page') || '').toLowerCase();
  let current = links.find(l => l.classList.contains('active')) || null;
  if(!current && pageHint){
    current = links.find(l => l.textContent.trim().toLowerCase().includes(pageHint));
  }
  const currentLabel = current ? current.textContent.trim() : 'Services';

  /* Update "Current:" pill */
  const currentEl = document.getElementById('lg-current-page');
  if(currentEl) currentEl.textContent = currentLabel;

  /* Ensure aria-current for a11y */
  links.forEach(l => l.removeAttribute('aria-current'));
  if(current) current.setAttribute('aria-current','page');

  /* Wire Details Rail updates on hover/focus for the three hub links */
  const rail = nav.querySelector('.lg-nav-details');
  function updateRail(label){
    const key = label.toLowerCase();
    const data = key.includes('advisory') ? detailsCopy.advisory
               : key.includes('scopeiq') ? detailsCopy.scopeiq
               : detailsCopy.services;
    if(!rail || !data) return;
    rail.querySelector('h4').textContent = data.title;
    rail.querySelector('p').textContent = data.desc;
    rail.querySelector('a').setAttribute('href', data.href);
  }
  links.forEach(link=>{
    const t = link.textContent.trim().toLowerCase();
    if(t.includes('services') || t.includes('advisory') || t.includes('scopeiq')){
      link.addEventListener('mouseenter', ()=>updateRail(t));
      link.addEventListener('focus', ()=>updateRail(t));
    }
  });

  /* Initialize rail to current */
  updateRail(currentLabel);

  /* Optional: close rail on Escape while focusing inside nav */
  nav.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
    if(e.key === 'Escape'){
      const closeBtn = nav.querySelector('.lg-nav-close');
      if(closeBtn) closeBtn.click();
    }
  });
})();
</script>

3) Verify your markup (quick checklist)

<body data-page="services"> ✔ (already present)

Hub links have data-tooltip strings ✔ (you already added them)

The active Hub link has class="lg-nav-link active" ✔ (present on “Services”)

Keep section IDs in Services Hub:

#services (Capabilities)

#process (How It Works)

#results (Impact)

#engagement (Ways to Partner)

No other HTML changes are required.

4) QA steps (desktop)

Open the page and click the Hub toggle.

You should see a “Current: Services Hub” pill under the header.

Hover Services / Advisory / ScopeIQ — a tooltip appears, and the Details Rail (right side) updates title + copy + link.

Scroll and confirm Services Hub subsection links (Capabilities, How It Works, Impact, Ways to Partner) are visible in the menu (because data-page="services").

Click each subsection; page scrolls smoothly to the right section.

Use keyboard (Tab) to focus links — a visible teal outline appears; tooltips show on focus.

Mobile/tablet

Tooltips are disabled (no hover).

Details Rail becomes an inline card below the nav sections so the explanatory copy is still visible.

5) Copy/tone (optional micro-polish)

If you want the Details Rail copy to fully mirror your tone, edit the detailsCopy object in the JS:

const detailsCopy = {
  services: {
    title: 'Services',
    desc: 'Strategic marketing + creative execution delivered as one integrated team.',
    href: '#services'
  },
  advisory: {
    title: 'Advisory',
    desc: 'Direct access to Luis for strategy, positioning and executive guidance.',
    href: './advisory/index.html'
  },
  scopeiq: {
    title: 'ScopeIQ',
    desc: 'A fast diagnostic to surface your growth priorities and next steps.',
    href: './scopeiq-wizard/index.html'
  }
};

6) Known good states / what “done” looks like

Menu title reads IMC Hub

Pill shows Current: Services Hub

Tooltips appear on hover/focus for the three Hub entries

Details Rail changes content when you move between Services / Advisory / ScopeIQ

Services subsections show only on the Services page

Keyboard focus rings are visible and brand-consistent
